notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot Updates to Version 1.3.5!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The darkness keeps evolving, and the journey into the nightmare becomes even more captivating. We are thrilled to announce the release of the 1.3.5 Update for Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell, designed to further refine the gameplay experience and respond to the incredible feedback you’ve shared with us.

Thanks to your reviews, livestreams, and suggestions, the game keeps getting better. We’ll never stop thanking you for your support, which is the driving force behind our development.

What’s new in the 1.3.5 Update?
Key improvements for a smoother experience:

 Optimized door interactions: If you don’t have the correct key, the inventory will no longer open automatically. Explore without interruptions!
 Improved Deer Woman AI: Her artificial intelligence has been further refined, and an annoying bug causing her to enter furniture while you were hiding has been fixed. Escaping her will now be even more chilling and realistic.
 More intuitive inventory: A notification has been added to alert you when your inventory is full. 
Thanks to you, the journey continues!

Thanks to your feedback, Scary Shadow Spot becomes increasingly immersive and refined. Every update is a new opportunity to explore the house with fresh eyes, and we can’t wait for you to experience Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass, the second episode in the series, coming soon!

Replay and leave a review!

Reviews are the best way to support the game and its future. Every piece of feedback helps not only improve the current experience but also shape a second episode that exceeds expectations. If you haven’t left a review yet, now is the perfect time!

A glimpse into the future: Bitter Glass

To prepare you for the next chapter in the series, we’ve added a sneak peek of Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass in the main menu. We can’t wait to reveal more details! Here’s a preview image of what awaits you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/9aa85d6b09ae36a67d8be1de176ae90715026af2.jpg

Thank you again for your support! The darkness is deeper than ever, and the journey has just begun.

Doesn't Matter Games Studio

notes.title: The Scary Shadow Spot update is finally available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's time to step back into the shadows!
The Scary Shadow Spot update is now available, and we can't wait for you to experience all the new features we've prepared for you. Thanks to your feedback and the live streams you've done on Twitch, we've worked hard to make the game even more immersive, terrifying, and engaging.

If you've already explored every corner of the house, now is the perfect time to step back inside. This update introduces new elements that you're sure to enjoy discovering.

What's new in this update?
Here are some of the new features we've added to enhance your gaming experience:

NEW FEATURES

 New jumpscares to make the experience even more intense.
 Added a new achievement: "NOSY".
 Added the ability to pause the game.
 Added new entries to the Main Menu.
 The Homunculus has a new look.
 Added several autosave points to make the experience less frustrating.


IMPROVEMENTS

 Added a visual marker to deposited vinyl records.
 Improved the text of the poem in the Mirror Room.
 Enhanced the game's color grading.
 Improved cutscene animations.
 Improved character facial expressions.
 Mirrored the text of the poem in the Mirror Room.


FIXES

 Fixed the skull's box collider in the Art Room and added a visual marker.
 Fixed the inverted "On/Off" switches.
 Fixed minor bugs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/c40dd639a66b3438ecea4e50ed5bfb3ab2e6374a.jpg

Can you find all the secrets we've added? Step back into the nightmare and discover what's hiding behind every shadow.

Thanks again for all your support, and as always, don't forget to leave a review! Your feedback is crucial for the future of Scary Shadow Spot and the next chapters we have planned.

WARNING
If you have a game in progress, this is a major update, and it is not possible to continue with your current saves. Continuing your game will cause malfunctions.

You have two options:
1) Start the game from scratch and enjoy all the new features.
2)Go to the game properties on Steam and select the previous version of the game in the "Beta" tab. This will restore the old version, allowing you to continue with your saves.

Doesn't Matter Games Studio

notes.title: New update for Scary Shadow Spot before the Steam Scream Festival!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I would like to take a moment to sincerely thank everyone who has already played Scary Shadow Spot. Your support and your gaming experiences have been essential for the continuous improvement of the project.

Reviews are incredibly important to me and are the best way to support the development of the next chapters. If you enjoyed the game or have any thoughts to share, a review on Steam can make a difference for the future of the series.

Thanks to feedback, we always improve! Watching your live streams on Twitch and reading your feedback has given me the opportunity to make some improvements to the game. This has allowed me to make Scary Shadow Spot even more engaging and terrifying.

New features coming for the Steam Scream Festival! With the upcoming Steam Scream Festival 3 on October 28, I want to take this opportunity to announce that I will be releasing a new update for the game in the days leading up to it! This update will include many new features and improvements that will surely surprise you. Here are just some of the new things you can expect:


 The ability to pause the game.
 New jumpscares to make the experience even more intense.
 A new achievement to unlock.
 Graphic improvements and new animations.
 And much more that I will reveal later...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139261/3ebb1849efea9958af44a20dbb1eb985b440fb90.jpg

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you from the bottom of my heart for your wonderful support! Don’t forget to leave a review to help me improve and develop new chapters for you.

notes.title: The official release of Scary Shadow Spot is here!
notes.notes:
Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell has an official release date! After months of hard work and refinement, we are thrilled to announce that the game will be available Friday, September 20, 2024.

[hr][/hr]

The Countdown Has Begun
The official release is just around the corner, and we couldn’t be more excited. This project, born out of passion and dedication, is finally ready to be shared with the world.

[hr][/hr]

A Psychological Horror Experience
In Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell, every door hides a secret, every shadow an enigma. Are you ready to explore the depths of the darkness? The line between reality and nightmare has never been so thin.

[hr][/hr]

Questions? We’re Here to Answer!
Curious to know more about Scary Shadow Spot? Want to dive deeper into the story or puzzles? We can’t wait to read your questions and interact with you. The wait is almost over, but the secrets are just beginning...

[hr][/hr]

The Big Launch Is Near!
Mark your calendars: September 20, 2024. Get ready to discover what lurks in the shadows. Thank you all for your incredible support so far, we’ll see you soon in the darkness of Scary Shadow Spot!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The Release is Near!
notes.notes:
Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell is now in its final stages! After months of hard work, I am thrilled to announce that the game is almost ready for the official release.

[hr][/hr]

Feedback from Beta Testers I had the privilege of having the game tested by a group of selected beta testers, and their feedback has helped refine every detail. The eerie atmosphere and twists that define the game have been polished to offer you an unforgettable experience.

[hr][/hr]

Inspired by The Twilight Zone The game is inspired by the legendary TV series The Twilight Zone. Every puzzle, every shadow, has been designed to make you doubt what is real and what lurks in the depths of the mind.

[hr][/hr]

Questions? We Are Here to Answer! Do you have any curiosities or questions about Scary Shadow Spot? We are here to answer anything that comes to mind. What secrets are hidden in Mark's house? What awaits you in the darkness? We can't wait to hear your questions!

[hr][/hr]

Thank You for the Support! Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release day.

[hr][/hr]
